description.value: Dorian Greek House is a Greek restaurant on Victoria Street in downtown Kamloops that has been serving traditional Greek cuisine since 2003. The menu features a broad range of classic Greek dishes with an emphasis on generous portions and customer satisfaction. It is a well-established sit-down dining option in a central Kamloops location, making it a viable meal stop for touring cyclists passing through the city.
